Equality requires one centered axis variance to vanish and one Fourier character to carry all one-dimensional fourth-moment mass; inversion yields the full one-axis scalar-character classification. Arithmetic expression, symbolic factorization and actual package verifier were replayed, with numerical tests supporting rather than proving the universal theorem. The sharp n=3 obstruction is computed directly; n=4 is expressly outside scope.
